note: Adapted from the original English description of Krishna & Emerson 1962 (new species; type locality Bandjar, western Java). The alate is known only from 1 female dewinged adult (morphotype) and the soldier from 14 specimens; the original does not describe the worker. Measurements are translated verbatim from Tables 8 and 9 of the original, in millimetres.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: The soldier is closely related to G. dilatatus, differing in the weaker constriction at the middle of the postmentum and the less rounded anterolateral corners of the pronotum; compared with G. brevicaudatus the head is longer and narrower, the anterior dorsal swelling of the frons blunt and indistinct, the mandibles shorter and the pronotum longer and narrower; compared with G. borneensis the head is larger and thicker, the anterior dorsal swelling blunt, the mandibles shorter and the pronotum wider; G. caudomunitus and G. niger are smaller in all parts, while G. montanus has a larger and thicker head, a steeper frontal slope, shorter mandibles, a straight posterior edge of the 2nd marginal tooth of the left mandible, and a longer and wider pronotum. Compared with G. dilatatus the alate has larger compound eyes of a different shape and a longer and wider pronotum with more broadly rounded anterolateral corners; compared with G. kirbyi the compound eyes are smaller and of a different shape and the posterolateral margins of the pronotum are rounded.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Head yellowish brown; the two corners of the postclypeus reddish brown; anteclypeus pale yellow; labrum brownish yellow; pronotum almost concolorous with the posterior part of the head; antennae yellowish brown; legs pale yellow; tergites pale yellowish brown; sternites yellow; wing scales smoky brown. Head with a few scattered erect setae; pronotal margins and disc with long and short setae. Head with the sides straight for a short distance behind the compound eyes, then broadly convex. Y suture faintly visible. Compound eyes large; ocelli large, oblique, touching the compound eyes. Anterior margin of the labrum straight. Antennae (of the specimen) broken, segment 2 slightly longer than segment 3, segment 3 equal to segment 4. Pronotum almost as wide as the head; anterior margin concave; lateral margins rounded; posterolateral margins rounded; posterior margin straight. Measurements (mm; single female dewinged adult morphotype): head length (to the tip of the labrum) 1.50; head length (to the lateral base of the mandibles) 1.13; head width 1.24; compound eye diameter 0.37; distance to the lower eye margin 0.17; ocellus length 0.18; pronotal median length 0.60, maximum length 0.73, width 1.20; hind tibia length 1.11; forewing scale length 0.99, width 0.68.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head yellowish brown, paler posteriorly, reddish brown around the antennal sockets and in the postclypeal region; antennae yellowish brown; labrum pale brown; mandibles shining, nearly black, brownish at the base; pronotum pale yellowish brown; tergites and legs pale yellowish brown. Head with a few scattered erect setae; pronotal margins and disc with long and short setae; the outer base of the mandibles with microtrichia. Head long; sides parallel; anterior dorsal swellings distinct, small, each with a small wart-like projection at the tip; frons concave in lateral view. Compound eyes large, nearly oval. Labrum slightly wider than long, anterolateral corners rounded. Mandibles long, the outer base swollen; left mandible with 3 marginal teeth, the 1st small and nearly conical, the 2nd with a concave posterior edge, the 3rd small; right mandible with 2 marginal teeth, the tip of the 1st marginal tooth 0.45 mm from the apical tooth. Postmentum long. Antennae 11—13-segmented, segment 2 equal to segment 4, segment 3 variable in length. Pronotum as wide as or slightly wider than the head; anterior margin broadly concave; posterolateral margins broadly rounded (in some specimens straight and angulate); posterior margin very shallowly emarginate. Femora slender. Measurements (mm; 14 soldiers, means in parentheses): head length (to the lateral base of the mandibles) 1.84—2.18 (2.06); head width 1.28—1.35 (1.34); head height 1.16—1.28 (1.21); left mandible length 1.09—1.20 (1.16); postmentum maximum width 0.41—0.49 (0.45), minimum width 0.23—0.30 (0.26), length 1.35—1.59 (1.48); pronotal median length 0.60—0.75 (0.66), maximum length 0.77—0.98 (0.83), width 1.24—1.40 (1.32); hind tibia length 0.98—1.05 (1.01).
